Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the monthly inspection of the main control building, in which the fire smoke detectors are located; they are responsible for sensing a fire inside these halls and giving an alarm on the main control screen in the control building.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Hennawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Kader and Eng. Hossam El-Rify, endorsed by Mr. Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Mr. Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawwan, Head of the El Nubaria Power Station Sector; the document was reviewed and endorsed by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator for the company, and certified by Mr. Eng. Mohamed Nageeb Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety precautions
Issue a work order approved by the competent authority, following the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment
Those carrying out the maintenance must hold an occupational safety and health category card
Fence off the area to define the work area and place warning signs
Wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...)
Tools and equipment used
Cleaning fluid, rags, straight edge
Any tools that produce smoke, such as pieces of cloth, matches, etc.
Procedures to be carried out
1. | Inspect the push button
2. | Maintain the smoke detector
3. | Test the push button and monitor it from the main control panel.
4. | Maintain the auxiliary control panels throughout the station and clean them
